# Casey Foundation Chinese School (Casey 中文学校)

> Community Saturday Chinese language school in Narre Warren, Victoria, Australia.
> Mandarin classes for children of all year levels — from complete beginners to
> advanced — serving families in Berwick, Cranbourne, Narre Warren, Hallam,
> Hampton Park, Endeavour Hills, Officer, Clyde and the wider City of Casey in
> Melbourne's southeast. The site also hosts a free online Chinese-character
> learning tool that anyone, anywhere can use.

Key facts:

- Classes: Saturdays, 9.00 AM – 5.00 PM, during Victorian school terms
- Location: 4a Malcolm Court, Narre Warren VIC 3805 (minutes from the Monash Freeway)
- Levels: all school year levels; children with no Chinese background start at the Beginning level (启蒙班)
- Free trial lesson for all new students
- Contact: office@caseychinese.org · +61 401 076 448
- Status: Incorporated Association in Victoria (Casey Foundation Chinese School Inc)

## Main pages

- [Home](https://caseychinese.org/): programs and levels, textbooks, fees, 2026
  term dates, enrolment, FAQ, events and contact details for the school
- [Enrolment](https://caseychinese.org/index.html#enrolment): how to enrol and
  book the free trial lesson

## Free Chinese character learning tool (识字小馆)

- [Learn Chinese Characters — interactive explorer](https://caseychinese.org/characters.html):
  free, no sign-up. 300 common Chinese characters with animated stroke order,
  Mandarin audio pronunciation, pinyin, English meanings, origin stories,
  example words and sentences, plus a guide to the 24 most useful radicals
- [All 300 characters — reference index](https://caseychinese.org/learn/characters/):
  a static reference page for every character (stroke-order diagrams, pinyin,
  meaning, etymology, a common word and an example sentence, each with audio),
  grouped by theme — useful for beginners and heritage learners practising
  reading and writing Chinese characters
